name: Hemogen i2000
summary: Fully automated, open chemiluminescence immunoassay (CLIA) analyzer with up to 200 tests per hour and the first result in 12 minutes or less. Compatible with HRP, AP, AE and ABEI magnetic-particle assays, with 60 sample positions, 25 refrigerated reagent positions and a built-in sample barcode reader.

specs.label: Principle
specs.value: AE, AP, ABEI or HRP magnetic particle-based CLIA

specs.label: Sample probe
specs.value: Single steel probe for both sample and reagent

specs.label: Probe detection
specs.value: Clot, air bubble and liquid level detection

specs.label: Sample types
specs.value: Serum, plasma, urine, whole blood, CSF and feces

specs.label: Reagent mixing
specs.value: Non-touch rotary mixing for magnetic particles

specs.label: Cardiac markers
specs.value: cTnI, cTnT, MYO, CK-MB, NT-proBNP, BNP, D-Dimer, LP-PLA2, H-FABP

specs.label: Hormones
specs.value: Total-hCGβ, FSH, LH, PRL, P, T, E2, Free Testo, AMH, Free-β-HCG, GH, SHBG, Cortisol, ACTH

specs.label: Thyroid
specs.value: TT3, FT3, TT4, FT4, TSH, rT3, Tg, TGAb, TPOAb

specs.label: Tumor markers
specs.value: AFP, CEA, total PSA, Free PSA, CA125, CA15-3, CA19-9, CA724, CA50, CA242, HE4, Cyfra211, NSE, ProGRP, SCCA, Fer, PIVKA II

specs.label: Infectious disease
specs.value: HBsAg, HBsAb, HBeAb, HBeAg, HBcAb, TP, HCV, HIV

specs.label: TORCH
specs.value: Toxo IgG/IgM, Rubella IgG/IgM, CMV IgG/IgM, HSV-1 IgG/IgM, HSV-2 IgG/IgM

specs.label: Helicobacter pylori
specs.value: H. pylori IgG, H. pylori IgM

features: Up to 200 tests per hour, first result in 12 minutes or less
Open system compatible with HRP, AP, AE and ABEI assay protocols
Incubation, washing and detection all in one unit
60 sample positions with a STAT channel for emergency samples at any time
One-piece reagent disc with 25 positions, refrigerated 24 hours at 2 – 8 °C
Intelligent magnetic separation for efficient washing
Single steel probe for sample and reagent, with clot, air bubble and liquid level detection
Patented probe washing keeps carryover very low
High-speed non-touch vortex mixing to avoid contamination
3D-motion gripper transfers assay cups accurately between stations
RFID reagent scanning, inner sample barcode reader and IoT cloud platform
15-inch touch screen with real-time consumables management, no mouse or keyboard needed
Broad menu of 90+ assays across cardiac, hormones, thyroid, tumor markers, infectious disease, TORCH and more
